answers.core:
- Performance: Core integration avoids bindings overhead.
- Ecosystem: First-party support attracts C++ developers.
- Consistency: Avoid fragmentation (e.g., everyone uses different GDNative setups).
answers.workaround:
No. Current workarounds:
- GDExtension: Requires manual setup, breaks editor tooling.
- C#: Still slower than native C++, depends on Mono/.NET.

title: First-class C++ support (alongside GDScript/C#) for high-performance scripting
